this bug happens because the new secured instances system has determined that you "shouldn't" be there, you were likely in an instance where the instance owner had logged out 
because of a bug in the system for tracking/determining who should be allowed it shows you the same error as if you tried to join that world from the menu, but instead while you were in the world.  there is no fix but restarting vrchat at that point, and asking your friends to create a new instance or creating one yourself
here is a related report to the issue:
https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/1229-you-are-not-allowed-to-travel-to-that-locationcontent-unavailable-bug

@{61e27c52de46a8443adc0ba9|full_name}: I saw that one, but that one happened while they were actually in the menu and the popup came up over the menu, which would at least make sense.
In my case, I had been in the world happily for 2 minutes before it started spamming dialogs at me.
Someone else said it was related to the secured instances feature too. I know the error message _says_ it is, but I'm not sure that's the problem actually going on.
According to the logs, after joining the world:
2022.09.10 13:01:46 Log        -  Joining friend: wrld_a5f01c1e-a54d-4156-af67-ba71bf803e06:04294~hidden(usr_6a71f9ca-2f64-452b-b68d-e5228838832b)~region(use)~nonce(DD2FBBD4F066BE0AC2AA2791B7A6452EE85259ABF0353949)
2022.09.10 13:02:49 Log        -  [Behaviour] OnPlayerJoinComplete hakanai
Then what _actually_ happened to me:
2022.09.10 13:07:51 Error      -  [Behaviour] Timeout: Your connection to VRChat timed out.
2022.09.10 13:07:51 Log        -  [Behaviour] Resetting game flow because "Your connection to VRChat timed out.": [RejoinInstance, SkipLogin]
At no point did it actually tell me I had timed out though - it just said it in the log.
Then:
2022.09.10 13:07:52 Error      -  [API] [294, 401, Post, -1] Abandoning request, because - "Missing Credentials"
2022.09.10 13:07:52 Error      -  [Behaviour] Could not enter room because: "Missing Credentials"
2022.09.10 13:07:57 Log        -  [Behaviour] showing alert
"Missing Credentials" sounds more like now I'm magically not logged in - but again, that's not the error it's showing.
And then:
2022.09.10 13:07:57 Log        -  [Behaviour] Going to Home Location: wrld_09123016-b74a-4921-b60e-58f50c8c4928
2022.09.10 13:07:57 Log        -  [Behaviour] Destination fetching: wrld_4432ea9b-729c-46e3-8eaf-846aa0a37fdd
2022.09.10 13:07:57 Log        -  [Behaviour] Fetching world information for wrld_4432ea9b-729c-46e3-8eaf-846aa0a37fdd
2022.09.10 13:07:57 Log        -  [Behaviour] Going to default home world since users Home World is not compatible with current platform
2022.09.10 13:07:57 Log        -  [Behaviour] Destination fetching: wrld_4432ea9b-729c-46e3-8eaf-846aa0a37fdd
2022.09.10 13:07:57 Log        -  [Behaviour] Starting transition to wrld_4432ea9b-729c-46e3-8eaf-846aa0a37fdd
2022.09.10 13:07:58 Error      -  [API] [297, 401, Post, -1] Abandoning request, because - "Missing Credentials"
2022.09.10 13:07:58 Error      -  [Behaviour] Could not enter room because: "Missing Credentials"
Each subsequent dialog was the game trying to send me to my home world, but failing with the same reason, "Missing Credentials".
So what _really_ happened - I got logged out by the game automatically for some reason, but instead of the game resetting and telling me that, it showed me this incorrect dialog over and over.
Also, my home world *absolutely* does support PC VR - so the message about it not being compatible with the current platform is also a lie.
The connection reset, i.e. networking issues, well, that isn't something anyone can do anything about.
**Summary of VRChat's sins:**
1. Suddenly deciding I was logged out even though I had only been in the game a few minutes and hadn't logged out of my own accord.
2. Use of modal dialogs in a VR application. In this case preventing me even opening the menu to go elsewhere or even quit.
3. Never telling me I had timed out even though the logs suggest that was the trigger for the issue.
4. Deciding my home world was not compatible with PC VR, when clearly it is. Potentially this is just incorrect error handling - they got the credentials error and instead of booting me out, just tried to join a different world.

@{5a4b034d1ab4366d42644996|full_name}: your information here is much more comprehensive and i can only hope it will let the developers fix this sooner
i only experienced the bug in-world once rather than in a menu, and based on your logs and description relating to network timeout i recall that the time i experienced the bug was very similar to network timeout.
at least in my experience, timeouts typically involve still being able to see and hear those around me while to them i am frozen and not speaking, when i had this issue crop up the same played out before the modal dialog popped up and locked me in place until i restarted

@{61e27c52de46a8443adc0ba9|full_name}: Yeah, I didn't have any idea what actually happened until reading the logs a day after. I was (and kind of still am) just pissed off at having an experience like that after having not played the game for a while, and finally being motivated enough to start it up. >:-/

details:
Experience:
- Opened VRChat
- Joined on a friend
- Walked around the world for a couple minutes trying to find where they were
- Found them
- Suddenly this popup
- I close the popup
- It pops up again
- I wonder what the fuck it's talking about because I have not asked to travel to anywhere and want to stay here please fuck off
- I close it again
- It pops up again
- After about 15 rounds of this and realising I couldn't access any other menus because of it, I closed VRChat.
My opinion: Modal dialogs have no place in a VR application. If you need to show the user a problem has occurred, make it some kind of overlay.

And whatever travel you're talking about, reword that so that it makes sense in this context.
title: Repeated "You're not allowed to travel to that location" popups despite not asking to travel anywhere
